title: Add Date/Time Order Option
instructions: Add a dropdown in DateTimeConfigDialog to choose whether date or time comes first in the display. Update the preview and Panel.update_time() to respect this order setting.

1785088990.280165.instruction: Add "order" field to datetime configuration with default value "date_time" (date first, then time). Also add "time_date" option for time first, then date. Update default config in both Panel and DateTimeConfigDialog.

1785088996.3180153.instruction: Add a QComboBox in the DateTimeConfigDialog for selecting display order. Options: "Date then Time" and "Time then Date". Connect it to update_preview() and save it in the config.

1785089001.7255564.instruction: Modify Panel.update_time() to check the "order" setting. If "date_time", build date first then time. If "time_date", build time first then date. Join with space separator.
